description: Forward an existing email to another recipient. The account's Gmail signature is appended automatically, so do not write a sign-off or signature in the body yourself; pass signature: false to send without it. The signature goes in the message's HTML part, so a plain-text body is sent as multipart/alternative when the account has one. The response's signature field reports what happened.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

attachments.description: Files to send with the message, at most 10, 25 MB in total. Each entry is a Drive file id as a string, or {"file_id": "", "as": ""} to send a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck as a file, or a file reference. Formats: Docs pdf, docx, txt, html, md, rtf, odt, epub; Sheets pdf, xlsx, csv, tsv, html, ods; Slides pdf, pptx, txt, odp. csv and tsv export one tab: add "tab": "" to choose it, otherwise the first tab goes, and the response says which. A Sheet as html arrives as a .zip of pages, one per tab; Slides as txt is the slides' visible text only. Google Docs, Sheets and Slides passed by id alone are sent as links in the message, the way Gmail does, not as files. Other Drive files are attached as they are. A file reference is an object with a "type": {"type": "gmail_message", "message_id": "<id>"} attaches an email as its original .eml, {"type": "gmail_attachment", "message_id": "<id>", "part_id": "<part id>"} one attachment of an email, {"type": "drive_file", "file_id": "<id>"} a Drive file as stored, {"type": "drive_export", "file_id": "<id>", "format": "pdf"} a Google file exported, {"type": "content", "name": "<file name>", "base64": "<standard base64, one unbroken string>"} a file the caller already holds, at most 1 MB, and {"type": "upload", "upload_id": "<id>"} a file the user sent through file_upload_link. A reference may carry an "account" naming the connected Google account that holds the email or file. Several entries may be references. Two attachments may not share a filename. To show an image in the body rather than at the bottom, reference it in html_body as <img src="cid:FILENAME">, where FILENAME is its Drive filename with any character other than letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore replaced by an underscore. Sharing a Drive link is the sender's responsibility; nothing here changes who can open a file. The response's attachments field reports each file as attached, inline, linked or exported, with its size and the SHA-256 of the bytes that went into the message; a file sent as a link has neither.

as.description: Export a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck in this format.

tab.description: For a Sheet as csv or tsv: the tab to export, by title. Defaults to the first tab.

anyOf.description: A file reference, resolved by the gateway and attached in this entry's place.

account.description: Which connected Google account holds the email or file. Not taken with content.

base64.description: With content: the file in standard base64 as one unbroken string, at most 1 MB decoded.

file_id.description: With drive_file and drive_export: the Drive file id.

format.description: With drive_export: the format to export to, such as pdf.

message_id.description: With gmail_message and gmail_attachment: the Gmail message id.

mime_type.description: With content, optional: the file's type; omitted, it comes from the name's extension.

name.description: With content: the file's name, with its extension.

part_id.description: With gmail_attachment: the attachment's part id as gmail_read lists it.

upload_id.description: With upload: the id from the receipt of a file sent through file_upload_link.

body.description: Optional plain-text note included above the forwarded message

html_body.description: Optional HTML note included above the forwarded message. The forward goes out with both an HTML part and a plain-text part, and the forwarded block is formatted with Gmail styling. Provide body or html_body, not both.

include_original_attachments.description: The original message's own attachments are forwarded with it, counted in the 25 MB limit. Set false to forward the text alone. Defaults to true.

message_id.description: The Gmail message ID to forward

signature.description: Set false to send without the account's Gmail signature, and to skip the lookup entirely. Defaults to true.

to.description: Recipient email address to forward to

name: gws-mcp__gmail_forward
